title: No display after update to Android 10
symptom: After updating to Android 10, the app no longer displays any data, although it shows connection in System Status and Event Log, and displays battery condition of the MM2 and Sensor Age, along with manual entries. Calibrations also disappeared from the Main Menu.
evidence_quote: After update to the Android 10, they app no longer displayed any data. It was not a connection issue as it showed connection in System Status and the Event Log.
